summary: Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 11,243,511 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for 5,241,997 shares, each paired with accompanying warrants for up to 16,123,189 shares. Combined price is $2.76 per share/warrant, or $2.759 per pre-funded unit less $0.001 exercise price. Accompanying warrants strike $3.45, exercisable after six months, expiring five years from initial exercise. Rodman Renshaw is exclusive placement agent at 5.75% cash fee plus 494,565 placement agent warrants. This is a routine capital-raising takedown, not a special situation; watch for dilution and warrant overhang.
